news.headline: Wall Street Zen Downgrades uniQure to Sell
news.summary: Wall Street Zen cut its rating on uniQure from Hold to Sell, citing lingering regulatory uncertainty around AMT-130, making it an outlier bearish voice versus the broadly bullish sell-side consensus (11 buy ratings, average target near $65-70).

news.headline: Wells Fargo Raises uniQure Price Target to $75 from $60, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing growing confidence in the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway as well as early encouraging AMT-260 epilepsy pipeline data.

news.headline: AdCom Expected for uniQure's Huntington's Gene Therapy, Chief Medical Officer Says
news.summary: During uniQure's Q2 2026 earnings call, Chief Medical Officer Walid Abi-Saab said the company believes an FDA advisory committee (AdCom) meeting for AMT-130 is likely and stated "we welcome it," while AMT-130 is still expected to be eligible for priority review given its Breakthrough Therapy and RMAT designations.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, $65 Price Target
news.summary: Analyst Rudy Li upgraded QURE from Peer Perform to Outperform, arguing the market is underpricing AMT-130's approval odds (Wolfe estimates ~70% probability) and projecting peak U.S. sales of about $2 billion.

news.headline: uniQure Reports Q2 2026 Results: Cash Runway Extended to 2030, Stock Rises Despite Wider Loss
news.summary: Revenue of $5.8M missed estimates and the quarterly net loss widened to roughly $81M, but shares jumped as the company reaffirmed cash of $810.3M funding operations into 2030, confirmed the AMT-130 BLA/UK MAA submissions remain on track for Q3 2026, and reiterated four-year topline AMT-130 data due in September 2026.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises uniQure Price Target to $80, Maintains Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target from $50 to $80 while reiterating a Buy rating, reflecting increased confidence following FDA's alignment on an accelerated-approval BLA pathway for AMT-130.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to release topline four-year data from the AMT-130 Phase I/II Huntington's disease study, covering 24 patients across the low- and high-dose cohorts.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Company reaffirmed at Q2 2026 earnings it remains on track to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA under the accelerated approval pathway, based on 3-year Phase I/II data, following the FDA's June 2026 alignment on this pathway.

catalysts.label: UK MAA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following a successful MHRA pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application in the UK based on the 3-year analysis.

catalysts.label: Agreement with FDA on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: FDA has asked uniQure to finalize the design of a required post-approval confirmatory trial, expected to be a randomized, standard-of-care-controlled study with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint.

catalysts.label: Possible FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 2026 call it believes an AdCom meeting is likely and welcomes it; outcome could influence review timing and market perception of approval odds.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 second dose cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second, higher-dose cohort in the GenTLE Phase I/IIa epilepsy study; early low-dose data showed meaningful seizure reductions in 3 of 6 patients.

catalysts.label: FDA priority review decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Potential accelerated approval decision timeline following BLA submission and (if granted) priority review; exact PDUFA date not yet set.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 updated Phase I/IIa data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present updated results from the epilepsy gene therapy program including further dose-cohort follow-up.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on prior-year cadence (Q3 2025 reported Nov 10, 2025); exact date not yet announced.

pulse: uniQure shares (~$44-46, up over 240% year-on-year) remain in a strongly positive news cycle following June 2026's FDA reversal that reopened an accelerated-approval path for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease: Q2 2026 earnings (July 29) reaffirmed Q3 2026 BLA/UK MAA filings and cash runway into 2030, and a string of analyst upgrades/price-target hikes (Wolfe to Outperform; Wells Fargo to $75; H.C. Wainwright to $80) reflect rising confidence in approval odds (~70% per Wolfe) and a multi-billion-dollar peak sales opportunity, though Wall Street Zen bucked the trend with a rare Sell downgrade on August 1 citing lingering regulatory risk. The company backstopped this window with a $259M equity raise in late June. The next major swing factor is the September 2026 four-year AMT-130 data readout, followed closely by the actual BLA/MAA filings and clarity on confirmatory-trial design and any AdCom timing.
